results.description: REGISTRATION_REJECT; evidence must include the reject frame.

final_json.summary: All three UEs failed registration due to inability to derive UE identity from the network, caused by 404 errors on critical SBI calls to AUSF, UDM, and UDR services.
final_json.failure_point: REGISTRATION_REJECT at seq 241 with mm_cause 9 (UE identity cannot be derived by the network)
final_json.root_cause: 5GMM cause 9: UE identity cannot be derived by the network - AMF failed to authenticate UEs because SBI calls to AUSF (/nausf-auth/v1/ue-authentications), UDM (/nudm-ueau/v1/suci-.../security-information/generate-auth-data), and UDR (/nudr-dr/v2/subscription-data/imsi-001010099999999/authentication-data/authentication-subscription) all returned 404 Not Found errors.

results.description: AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE (MAC). Root cause must mention MAC/authentication.
